title: ExecMesh: A Compute-Backed Financial Infrastructure for the AI Economy
content: ExecMesh introduces two fundamental innovations to blockchain infrastructure: compute credits as DeFi primitives and recursive proof composition for verifiable multi-agent workflows. By transforming verified computational output into tradeable, collateralizable assets and enabling cryptographic composition of work across multiple agents, ExecMesh creates the foundational layer for a compute-backed economy. Global compute markets exceed $500B annually; ExecMesh makes this value programmable.
